notes.title: 2024/03/14 Version update note
notes.notes:
* Enhance the missing and removed story content in the initial game release to ensure a comprehensive backstory is included in Ghost Wall. Enable players to decrypt and explore the complete narrative of the game.
* Introduce the main character's return to the old house and incorporate a new map into the gameplay experience.
* Resolve a bug that hindered game progress during the early release phase.
* Aligning with the storyline, adjust the game flow by incorporating NPCs and dialogues. Fine-tune game content and performance effects. Minimize unnecessary facial gestures, lower overall horror elements, and prioritize storytelling aspects for an enhanced gaming experience.

notes.title: 2024/01/12 Version Update Instructions
notes.notes:
* Optimized the collision of some items
* Fixed the problem of powder beads getting stuck into the ground
* Optimized the pattern of puzzle solving
* Cell phone messages can now be auto-replied

notes.title: 2024/01/11 Version Update Instructions
notes.notes:
System fixes:

* Added opening instruction and operation guide
* Removed the pickup animation of the protagonist, and the items will go into the backpack directly when pressing the E key
* Modified the introduction of the archive interface


Game process fixes:

* Adjusted the rotation speed of the green jade box
* Fixed the bug of picking up glue in the house
* Adjusted the turning speed of the bronze mirror
* Removed the female ghost protruding face in Greed's room.
* Tweaked Greed's model.
* Fine-tuned the appearance of the female ghost in white clothes
* Adjusted the refreshing position of the ghost fire in the yard.

notes.title: 2024/01/10 Version Update Instructions
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786803/2bbe80408538c29055754889140448fda1cf7cec.png

* Updated and fixed the issue of being killed by AI while reading information or viewing items. 
* Added a prompt and confirmation button to inform players that restarting the game will clear their progress.
* Removed unnecessary cluttered information and text.
* Lowered the difficulty of the White Lady ghost. She no longer jumpscares when players crouch to hide.
* Brightened up dark night scenes by adding lighting in different areas to increase visibility.
* Deleted an unnecessary jumpscare from a female ghost. 

Upcoming: 
——Regarding the story, we are working overtime to complete and fill in missing parts of the first version's storyline.
——We are updating item descriptions and acquisition based on the story.
——Revamping horror atmosphere and refining jumpscare mechanics for female ghosts according to the story plotline.
